generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
The RS274/NGC simulator is complete. Here's a summary of what I built:

**Project structure** at `output/`:
- `Cargo.toml` — empty `[dependencies]`, stable Rust 2021 edition
- `src/main.rs` — entry point, dispatches to `simulator::run`
- `src/parser.rs` — line/word/expression parsing per Appendix E
- `src/expr.rs` — expression evaluation (parameters, binary ops, unary funcs)
- `src/state.rs` — machine state (modal groups, coordinate systems, units)
- `src/exec.rs` — block execution following Table 8 order
- `src/motion.rs` — motion sub-motion generation, arc geometry, time/distance/tolerance stepping
- `src/canned.rs` — canned cycles G81–G89 with sticky values
- `src/cutter.rs` — cutter radius compensation
- `src/trace.rs` — trace recorder with delta encoding
- `src/output.rs` — final state JSON serializer
- `src/paramfile.rs` / `src/toolfile.rs` — RS274 parameter/tool file IO
- `src/json.rs` — minimal JSON writer (no external deps)
- `src/simulator.rs` — CLI parsing and top-level run loop

**Verified functionality**:
- Spec example 1 (linear motion) matches exactly
- Spec example 2 (G81 canned cycle with sub-motion expansion) matches
- Spec example 3 (error case with H99 / no tool table) matches
- C.1 Hello World, C.2 expression test, full C.3 canned cycle test all run
- Probe with `--probe-box`, M2/M30 reset, percent-demarcated files, parameter IO all work
- Exit codes: 0 success, 1 spec error, 2 internal/CLI error
- Trace stepping in all three modes (time, distance, tolerance) works

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
